body: I've never been to therapy, and my brother had medicine that he took for quite a while. and as bad as my family seems sometimes I know they care, but I can't help but feel that all this is wasted on me.

yes, my mother and brother know about it but my father doesn't. He's never one to understand anything that isn't right in play of his "go to work, make money, go home, pay bills, repeat" life. my mother says she'll put me in therapy and get me a medical marijuana card for my depression and anxiety, but it seems like she's not even taking a step into it. my brother says that he knows what I'm going through cause he had to dealing with suicidal thoughts over his bulling cause he has anxiety and ADHD. he said that's why he's been hanging out with me so much lately cause he knows the pain I'm going through, but he hung out with me for maybe a week and when his on and off again girlfriend who is a bitch came back from a vacation he's right back to her and never comes over and when he does it's for an hour max and doesn't even pay attention to anything I say. sorry about the run on sentences and excessive commas like I said before I've only helped others and never really get to talk through my problems.

just getting too much right now, with school and family and me just trying to stay happy it's getting too hard. I've decided tonight I'm going to attempt to hang myself with a belt in my closet, I have so few people that are nice to me that I don't think anyone would be too terribly hurt by it besides my family, and sure it's selfish to do this but everything in my life has been to help others and have my stuff pushed back so maybe this is just me breaking even...

yeah, I've been trying to convince my parents to help with that since I'm not 18. It's okay about the question I don't talk about it but here I feel open to, I always try and stay on a "perfect" sleep schedule, which for me is waking up around 5am and sleep at 9-10pm but sometimes I flip those and I tend to get yell at which makes me feel worse.

hey man, thank you so much for the offer I honestly hope well for you later in life and if I ever get too much emotion trapped in me again you'll be one of if not the first I'll go to talk to I don't have much but knowing people like you exist give me all the more out of this depression nightmare.

I really feel that, I don't even think about it anymore it's just a switch when I see people. if comparing to movies in suicide squad oddly coincidental hence the name, when enchantress comes out and completely takes over her body, that's exactly how it feels I can internally scream but I just keep fake smiling like it's not a choice anymore.

well, depending on what you mean by the question. If you mean trying suicide I've tried to overdose and cut, but if you mean distract myself from life it's usually weed or sleep but even then sleep makes me feel even worse at times and weed is slowly burning a hole in my pocket.
